prompt: A leathery, deeply tanned man in his fifties with oiled, creased skin, a gold chain and a fixed intense stare sits on a sun lounger on a bright beach, framed chest up in the slightly wobbly, soft focus of a phone held at arm's length. He looks straight into the lens with total seriousness, and his brows are lowered and level. Behind him is a pale strip of sand, a flat grey-blue sea and a bleached sky, and the light is harsh midday sun blowing out his shoulders and the sky to white. Oversaturated skin, clipped highlights and mild compression. Thanks.
